name: Know Enemy
tagline: Keeps a running read on the rivals you name, drawn only from what is already public
description: You hand it the list of companies you want watched, and from then on it works strictly from material anyone could look up. Short briefings arrive at a regular beat with the movements worth knowing about, and in between you can call up a profile on any single rival the moment a deal or a launch makes it urgent.
author: SaaSocalypse
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
